title: coord.store_of gives a linked worktree's store as a normalised path when git cannot run
goal: coord.store_of of a linked worktree with git off PATH returns the main clone's .git/kb-coord/coord.sqlite with no .. segments, so the absent-store reason stays readable; the reason keeps the store's file name on an 80-column view

run:
import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();m=os.path.join(d,'main');w=os.path.join(d,'wt1')
s.run(['git','init','-q',m],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',m,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@corp.example.com','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','x'],check=True)
s.run(['git','-C',m,'worktree','add','-q',w],check=True)
os.environ['PATH']=os.path.join(d,'nogit');import coord
p=coord.store_of(w);print(p);sys.exit(0 if p and '..' not in p.replace('\\','/').split('/') and os.path.realpath(p)==os.path.realpath(os.path.join(m,'.git','kb-coord','coord.sqlite')) else 1)
